# Country-scope helper triggers for the 16 Historical & Regional Peace Treaties.

oe_pt_in_europe = {
	capital ?= {
		continent = continent:europe
	}
}

oe_pt_in_asia = {
	capital ?= {
		continent = continent:asia
	}
}

oe_pt_in_eurasia = {
	capital ?= {
		OR = {
			continent = continent:europe
			continent = continent:asia
		}
	}
}

	OR = {

		owns = location:alexandria

	}
}

oe_pt_has_indian_ocean_port = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:kozhikode
		owns = location:goa
		owns = location:hormuz
		owns = location:malacca
		owns = location:adan
		owns = location:kilwa_kisiwani
		any_owned_location = {
			is_coastal = yes
			OR = {
				sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
				sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				region = region:arabia_region
				region = region:persia_region
				region = region:swahili_coast_region
				region = region:somalia_region
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_pt_is_celestial_suzerain = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		has_or_had_tag = CHI
		has_or_had_tag = YUA
		has_or_had_tag = MNG
		has_or_had_tag = MCH
	}
}

oe_pt_has_plunderable_art = {
	any_work_of_art_in_country = {
		art_is_priceless = no
	}
}

oe_pt_has_scholarly_heritage = {
	OR = {
		num_works_of_art >= 2
		any_owned_location = {
			has_building = building_type:university
		}
	}
}
